title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I am working on a project about the 10th anniversary of Galarraga game. It is an “oral history” where I am talking to as many people from different viewpoints. If you have anything that you think may be useful, behind-the-scenes, let me know
You may not, but I wanted to see. I talked to Dave yesterday and I don’t like quoting Dave in Tigers stories without reaching out to you, too
I’m on a conference call.  I have all day. I will call you back
